findings.title: Failed commit is retried with hooks disabled
findings.evidence: run_git_sentinel retries every nonzero git commit using --no-verify. add-objective/add-milestone/update-status/iter call it at lines 159,196,225,270.
findings.trigger: A pre-commit or commit-msg policy hook rejects an objective change.
findings.impact: The automatic retry can commit the rejected tree without its validation hooks.

findings.title: Objective commands stage unrelated work
findings.evidence: run_git_sentinel runs git add . from WORKSPACE_DIR before committing; callers mutate the objectives YAML and optionally PROJECT.md.
findings.trigger: Run an objective mutation while unrelated tracked edits or nonignored untracked files exist.
findings.impact: Unrelated work is staged and committed under the objective message, potentially capturing private or unfinished files.

findings.title: Merkle evidence seal does not bind field names
findings.evidence: compute_merkle_root hashes only each value then sorts the leaf hashes at line 705; main stores this root as merkle_seal at 2935-2940.
findings.trigger: Swap values of author and text, or rename evidence fields while retaining the multiset of values.
findings.impact: Different evidence records have the same seal without a SHA-256 collision, undermining the advertised tamper evidence.

findings.title: Native Hamming batch accepts buffers shorter than its stride
findings.evidence: flat_batch joins arbitrary byte strings; q_len alone is passed as the native stride without validating each length. Cross-file utils/void_accel.c:28,34-35 and 58,64-65 read each target at i*len.
findings.trigger: A compatible native library is loaded and a batch member is shorter than query.
findings.impact: Native code reads outside the provided batch buffer; malformed input can crash the process or compute distances from unrelated memory. Native-library loading was not exercised.

findings.title: Blackboard resolution is not an atomic OPEN transition
findings.evidence: resolve reads and checks OPEN at 288-292, then UPDATE uses only WHERE tuple_id = ? and commits. Independent CortexWalStore connections use the same SQLite database.
findings.trigger: Two processes read the same OPEN tuple before either resolution commits.
findings.impact: Both can succeed and the later resolution overwrites the first status, verifier and evidence, violating the documented OPEN-only state transition.

findings.title: JSON output skips requested claim export
findings.evidence: run_single_cycle returns immediately for json_output at 244-246; export_claims is processed only at 277-280.
findings.trigger: Invoke the CLI with --json --export-claims PATH and a cycle containing claim receipts.
findings.impact: The command exits successfully without creating the explicitly requested receipt file.

findings.title: Generated Python CI hides failed tests
findings.evidence: generate_ci_scaffold("python") emits python -m pytest || true; --scaffold-ci prints that template at 313-315.
findings.trigger: Use the generated workflow in a Python repository with failing tests or missing pytest.
findings.impact: The test step succeeds despite test failure, allowing CI to advertise green validation.

findings.title: Manifest inspector certifies properties it never checks
findings.evidence: The branch condition at 118 checks native mode, address alignment, and halt state, then prints Landauer Bound OK and Fail-Stop Gate OK. It does not test either property or even include is_consistent in acceptance.
findings.trigger: Run --inspect-manifest with a native aligned nonhalted manifest.
findings.impact: CLI presents unsupported physical and fail-stop guarantees as checked invariants.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Guard ignores allowed_capabilities and validate_tool_execution always returns True. No execution consumer was found in the targeted babylon60 search, so a live authorization bypass is not established.
A loadable library lacking both expected symbols leaves _accel truthy and _accel_func None; scalar and batch fallback call each other recursively. Requires that library configuration; not exercised.

coverage.notes: Direct symlink target .babylon60rules verified without following it.

tool_limitations: Native codebase-memory graph tools not exposed: ALL_TOOLS search for search_graph/index_repository returned no matches. Targeted text reads/searches used.
No tests, builds, runtime launches, or external API checks were run, as required.
Source inventory SHA-256 values matched all assigned regular text files.
